# Hood Riser Installation

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Identify two existing bolts per hinge and insert a stack of flat washers between the hood and hinge body. [t1856]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Identify the two existing bolts on each hinge that hold the hood down.
2. Remove the bolt closest to the front of the vehicle completely.
3. Back out the remaining bolt (closest to the windshield) about halfway.
4. [Partial] Insert a stack of flat washers into the gap between the hood and hinge body, adjusting quantity for desired height.
5. [Partial] Slide the new M8 x 1.25 x 30mm bolts through the washer stacks on both sides.
6. [Partial] Tighten the bolt closest to the windshield first until snug against the stack of washers.
7. [Partial] Back out the front-most bolt slightly, then slide it back in and tighten completely.

_Procedure reported by [t1856]._

## Parts

- Flat washers, quantity varies [t1856]
- M8 x 1.25 x 30mm bolts [t1856]

## Tips & gotchas

- Keep the bolts on the opposite side tight while working on one hinge. [t1856]
- [Partial] Ensure washers are placed correctly relative to the hinge orientation. [t1856]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Placing washers incorrectly on the first attempt, requiring re-adjustment of bolt angle. [t1856]
